rows.en: ＊Sakaki＊＠１２３＿０１８Good work. Looks like you were￥working hard again today.＝＠１２３＿０１９You've gotten used to this place￥and you're finally showing what￥you can really do.
＊Sakaki＊＠１２３＿０２０It's only natural to feel the￥pressure, but...｝￥＠１２３＿０２１Try not to let it get to you.
＊Sakaki＊＠１２３＿０２２Give it everything you've got,￥and I hope your results live up￥to our expectations.
＊Kaname＊＠１２３＿０２６Cousiiin! You and Yuri sure￥looked awfully cozy, huh?!
＊Kaname＊＠１２３＿０２７So you really do go for older,￥sexy women?
＊Kaname＊＠１２４＿００１Reeeally? 'Cause you were￥staring at Yuri the whole time!
＊Kaname＊＠１２４＿００２Aww... I guess I just can't￥compete with an older woman...
＊Kaname＊＠１２４＿００５But hey! Maybe someday I'll be￥even sexier than Yuri.￥You never know!
＊Kaname＊＠１２４＿００７You've always been like this,￥Cousin.＝＠１２４＿００８You never really notice me.
＊Kaname＊＠１２４＿００９Same when we were little.＝＠１２４＿０１０I was always chasing after￥you, Cousin.＝＠１２４＿０１１And yet...
＊Kaname＊＠１２４＿０１４Eek!!＝＠１２４＿０１５No!! It's pitch black!＝＠１２４＿０１６Wh-where are you, Cousin?!
＊Kaname＊＠１２４＿０２５R-right.＝＠１２４＿０２６It's probably just a little￥glitch that switched the lights￥to night mode...
＊Kaname＊＠１２５＿００２It's strange...＝＠１２５＿００３Being like this, I just￥naturally calm down...＝＠１２５＿００４Come to think of it...￥something like this happened￥to us before, right?
＊Kaname＊＠１２５＿００６Yeah... It was a long time￥ago, so I guess it's no wonder￥you forgot.

＊Kaname＊＠１２５＿００７Back then... we were both￥still little...＝＠１２５＿００８We went off on an "adventure,"￥walking to the next residential￥area, where we'd never been.＝＠１２５＿００９We found a sealed-off supply￥warehouse there...＝＠１２５＿０１０We called it our "secret base"￥and went inside, but then we got￥locked in...＝＠１２５＿０１１It was pitch dark back then too,￥just like this...＝＠１２５＿０１２And I remember calming down,￥listening to your heartbeat￥against my back...＝＠１２５＿０１３It's been over eight years...￥and I haven't changed at all.
＊Kaname＊＠１２５＿０１４If I'm the only one who hasn't￥changed... and I end up holding￥you back...

＊PA＊＠１２５＿０１８Due to a minor error, power to￥the lighting was temporarily￥cut off, but...＝＠１２５＿０１９There's no other effect on the￥facility whatsoever, so please￥don't be alarmed.＝＠１２５＿０２０Some shutters may drop and the￥lights may dim for a bit, but￥it will all be restored soon.＝＠１２５＿０２１...Eh, not like anybody's￥listening. That's all...
＊Kaname＊＠１２５＿０２４I'm going to try even harder￥from now on.＝＠１２５＿０２５So I don't hold you back like I￥did when we were little!
＊Narusawa＊＠１２５＿０２６Good work again today.＝＠１２５＿０２７Looks like you've gotten used to￥this place and you're finally￥showing what you can do.

＊Narusawa＊＠１２５＿０２９I'm counting on you to deliver￥good results.
